Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1251
Claimant:
Jennifer Watts
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
4-25-24
Claim reported by the insured's representative following a collision at an intersection where our driver was turning left
across oncoming traffic. The claimant's attorney has requested that all contact be routed through their office.
5-17-24
Reviewed the police report, which confirms the claimant's vehicle was involved and that the claimant was present in
the driver's seat at the scene. Two independent witnesses and the other driver describe the collision the same way,
and scene photos are consistent with that account.
7-21-24
Inspected the vehicle damage. The pattern and location of the impact match the described collision, and there is no
sign of earlier damage to the same areas. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy's coverage
start.
8-27-24
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy as a named driver. The claimant has given the same account of events in
each conversation so far, with no changes in the sequence of events.
9-9-24
Medical records show a shoulder injury, which fits the type and force of impact described. No prior injury to the same
body area is known from the claimant's history or available records. Treatment has followed a typical course and
eased as the claimant improved.
10-18-24
Based on the documentation reviewed, the injury, vehicle damage and liability picture are consistent with the reported
loss. Claim remains open pending final medical updates and settlement discussions with counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
